episodes.title: Ictus
episodes.summary: Sophie's physical wounds have healed, but she's still plagued by memory loss and a feeling that her life is not as it seems.

episodes.title: Muscle Memory
episodes.summary: Her suspicions of her husband growing, Sophie attempts to get away from James and learn the real truth about their marriage.

episodes.title: New Person, Same Old Mistakes
episodes.summary: Caroline's betrayal has Sophie doubting who—and what—to believe. Sophie looks to Baden for answers, and a motive is finally revealed.

episodes.title: Psychogenic
episodes.summary: Sophie pushes the boundaries of her recovery, hoping to excavate the secrets buried deep in her mind.

episodes.title: It Comes in Waves
episodes.summary: A risky choice lands Sophie in the throes of a hallucinogenic trip that makes her question what kind of person she really is—or was.

episodes.title: The Myth of California
episodes.summary: James is finally honest with Sophie about their marriage and their past. His betrayals run deep, but not as deep as her own.

episodes.title: It Was Always Going to End This Way
episodes.summary: Sophie must end the investigation into her own crimes, and she realizes there's only one explanation left for what happened on the ferry.

episodes.title: See You on the Other Side
episodes.summary: Season finale. Sophie seems ready to move forward, but can she accept a life with James while questions about her past still linger?

episodes.title: New Money
episodes.summary: Sophie makes a power play to establish herself in the Huntleys' world and reconnect with Eliza. A journalist contacts Sophie to be his source.

episodes.title: Speak of the Devil
episodes.summary: Eliza and Sophie rekindle their relationship. At Quinn and Grace's engagement party, tensions rise and an unexpected guest shows up.

episodes.title: Kintsugi
episodes.summary: Callum warns Sophie about the danger of trying to take down the Huntleys, as she deals with a new complication from her past.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.summary: Sophie returns to the Huntley estate—and makes a shocking discovery. James crosses paths with Quinn while trying to uncover Sophie's motives.

episodes.title: Daybreak
episodes.summary: Sophie tells James what she's discovered. Henry comes clean to Quinn and Eliza. Callum digs into Sophie's past and confronts her with the truth.

episodes.title: Atonement
episodes.summary: Henry arranges to meet with Sophie, hoping to buy her silence. Sophie turns to James for comfort. Callum questions who to trust.

episodes.title: What Comes Around
episodes.summary: James gets caught in the Huntleys' crosshairs as the walls close in on Sophie.

episodes.title: Unearthed
episodes.summary: Season finale. The truth surfaces and leaves Sophie with one question: What's her next move?
